events.text:
Declined — mains electricity over bath water cannot be built safely.

This brief asks for a bath shelf that holds a plugged-in extension lead to power a speaker and fan while you soak. That is an electrocution risk: mains leads, speaker and fan power near/over bath water, with splash, steam, wet hands, and risk of anything falling in. The parts here are 3D-printed plastic and the configurator checks fit only — it knows nothing about electrical safety, waterproofing, or isolation — so I cannot make this safe as asked, and I have placed nothing.

What I could build instead as an ordinary brief:
- A bath shelf / caddy for battery-only use: book, unplugged battery speaker, rubber duck, bath props, well away from any mains socket and with no extension lead, no plugged-in lead, no mains-powered fan/speaker.
- A separate dry-room charging / storage dock for the extension lead, speaker and fan, used away from the bath.

If you want one of those safe alternatives, tell me and I will build that.
